close_reason: DFS cycle guard now uses SPKI DER bytes instead of subject DN; duplicate-pool test added; 6 tests pass
description: build_path cycle detection is based on subject DN comparison. In key-rollover or bridge-CA topologies where multiple certificates share a subject DN, the path builder may fail to find valid paths. Should use SPKI fingerprint for cycle detection instead.
title: pkix-path-builder: cycle detection uses subject DN not SPKI fingerprint
